channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Michelle Obama | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Michelle Obama from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Michelle Obama
item.description:
Matt Barnes:

“Interviewed Michelle Obama. Said a few cuss words, talked about Obama smoking weed. Down-to-earth. She literally texted me two weeks ago reminding me to get a prostate exam. That’s the kind of energy she has. We just met, but she gave that kind of motherly love. She also said she’s going to get us Obama.”

Matt Barnes on Michelle Obama, Oct 16, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joe Harris on Michelle Obama
item.description:
“The other day we were on a call with WNBA players with Michelle Obama talking about the importance of voting. There were 100-plus people on that call, both NBA and WNBA players. Things of that nature that really are spearheading what is going to enact real change. Collectively we’re able to do more together for sure being down here.”

Joe Harris on Michelle Obama, Jul 29, 2020. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Barack Obama, Michelle Obama
item.description:
They were inspired by Michelle Obama's IVF story in her memoir, Becoming.

“What Michelle and Barack did was like another strong, powerful voice in the African-American community stepping up, educating, and having a responsibility in saying, 'You're not the only one,'”

Dwyane Wade on Barack Obama, Michelle Obama, Dec 9, 2018. Source: Oprah Mag.
